title: Preserve progress history and expose current state only for a unique head
preconditions: Use work item core with initial progress; merge two branch events blocked and cancelled with the same initial parent.

steps.expected_result: There are two heads, CurrentProgress is nil and progress_heads conflict remains explicit.

steps.action: Record a cancelled event naming both heads; reload.
steps.expected_result: One new event is returned, one head remains and the progress conflict is gone.

steps.action: Query work-events --kind progress for core before and after reconciliation.
steps.expected_result: All prior states and parent links remain queryable; work-items exposes current state only after unique-head reconciliation.

expected_result: Concurrent progress is preserved instead of arbitrarily selecting a current state.
